name: perfecteval
description: Provider-agnostic evaluation and review workflows for proving work is done, finding regressions, comparing candidates, diagnosing failures, and maintaining durable quality gates across models, agents, prompts, products, and repositories.

interface.longDescription: Design and run evidence-first evaluations for models, agents, prompts, applications, features, bugs, and repository-backed work. Perfect Eval classifies risk, writes capability and regression evals, verifies outcomes, performs an independent review, iterates with convergence limits, learns durable review rules, tests user-facing work from a first-time-user perspective, and diagnoses reproducible bugs. It is model/provider agnostic, repository agnostic, works without subagents, and supports session-scoped human-in-the-loop or autonomous operation.
capabilities: Turn requirements and failures into evals
Independently review work for missed failures
Iterate build-verify-review loops with stop rules
Convert recurring misses into learned review rules
Test user-facing work from a first-time-user perspective
Diagnose root causes and create regression protection
Compare models, providers, prompts, agents, or workflows fairly
Use connected repository evidence without requiring CI automation
defaultPrompt: Use Perfect Eval to prove whether this work is actually complete and identify any regressions.
Use Perfect Eval to compare these candidates under the same task bank and decision rules.
Use Perfect Eval to evaluate this repository change, diagnose failures, and create regression protection.
